title: Indian Stock Markets End Slightly Lower in Special Diwali Muhurat Trading
summary: Indian benchmark equity indices closed marginally lower during the traditional Diwali Muhurat trading session marking the start of Samvat 2083. The modest dip ended a seven-day rally in domestic equity markets.
point1: Benchmark indices finished slightly lower during the symbolic one-hour Diwali trading session.
point2: The session marked the official commencement of the new Hindu accounting year Samvat 2083.
point3: Standard market operations will resume following festive market holidays.

title: Delhi Air Quality Degrades to 'Very Poor' Category on Diwali
summary: Air quality across New Delhi dropped significantly on Diwali day, recording an overall Air Quality Index of 376. Certain areas like Jahangirpuri recorded severe readings reaching as high as 450.
point1: Delhi's average AQI hit 376, with toxic haze pushing localized areas into severe ranges.
point2: Reflects annual pollution spikes that pose public health risks across the National Capital Region.

title: Death Toll Rises to Four in Assam Oil India Limited Facility Fire
summary: The casualty count from an industrial fire at an Oil India Limited facility in Assam reached four after another injured worker died from his injuries. Management suspended four officials and initiated an internal inquiry.
point1: Four workers have died as a result of the industrial fire at the Assam plant.
point2: Oil India Limited suspended four personnel and ordered a high-level probe into the incident.
point3: A formal investigation committee has been instituted to establish accountability.

title: Houthis Report At Least 33 Killed in Air Strike in Yemen
summary: Houthi officials reported that an air strike carried out by the Saudi-led coalition killed at least 33 people in Yemen. The coalition has not issued an official statement regarding the report.
point1: Houthi officials stated that 33 individuals died in a coalition air attack.
point2: Highlights ongoing military engagements and casualties in the regional conflict.

title: Indian Oil Corporation to purchase crude and LPG tankers over West Asia supply risks
summary: Indian Oil Corporation's board has approved the purchase of crude oil and LPG shipping vessels. The decision follows Middle East geopolitical crises that highlighted vulnerability in energy supply chains.
point1: IOC's board approved buying dedicated crude and LPG ships to secure energy transport.
point2: Acquiring fleet tonnage is designed to insulate India's largest refiner against global supply chain disruptions.
point3: Tenders for ship procurement were issued several months ago as purchasing moves forward.

title: Adani Enterprises targets up to ₹40,000 crore annual capital expenditure
summary: Adani Enterprises has planned an annual capital expenditure of ₹35,000 to ₹40,000 crore for the next two fiscal years. The capital deployment will focus on operational expansion across airports, data centers, and manufacturing units.
point1: Adani Enterprises announced plans for ₹35,000-40,000 crore annual capex over the next two years.
point2: The funding aims to bring major infrastructure projects into full commercial operation.
point3: The investment strategy will be rolled out over the next two fiscal years.

title: Bishnoi gang member Hari Boxer detained in U.S. pending extradition to India
summary: Lawrence Bishnoi gang member Hari Boxer has been detained in the United States following joint coordination by Indian and international authorities. Extradition proceedings have been initiated to bring him back to India.
point1: Hari Boxer was apprehended in the U.S. through coordinated action by Rajasthan AGTF, CBI, and Interpol.
point2: The detention is a significant law enforcement breakthrough against international networks of criminal gangs.
point3: Indian legal authorities are working with U.S. counterparts to finalize formal extradition.

title: NDA Secures Dominant Lead in Andhra Pradesh Local Body Elections
summary: The ruling National Democratic Alliance coalition in Andhra Pradesh established a decisive lead in local ZPTC and MPTC elections. Telugu Desam Party candidates secured key constituencies, including wresting Pulivendula ZPTC from the opposition YSRCP.
point1: TDP and NDA coalition partners won a vast majority of local council seats counted.
point2: TDP defeated YSRCP in the prominent Pulivendula ZPTC constituency.
point3: Final tallying for remaining local body seats continues.

title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Calls for Military Readiness at Eastern Airbase
summary: Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh urged service personnel at a strategic eastern airbase near the China border to maintain top military preparedness. During his review, he assessed border infrastructure developments and operational readiness along the Line of Actual Control.
point1: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inspected defense positions at an airbase close to the China frontier.
point2: Singh warned of adversaries attempting to exploit security gaps and demanded maximum readiness.

title: Israel's President Tasks Opposition Leader Eisenkot With Forming Government
summary: Israeli President has officially tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government following last week's general election. Neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor his political rivals secured a parliamentary majority.
point1: Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot received the presidential mandate to assemble a government.
point2: Neither PM Netanyahu's coalition nor the opposing bloc secured an outright majority in the vote.
point3: Coalition negotiations between political parties are now officially underway.

title: Chinese Technology Exec Recruited to Spy on Nvidia CEO, US Intel Memo Says
summary: A U.S. intelligence memo circulated earlier this year alleges that China's Ministry of State Security recruited an executive from Megaspeed to spy on Nvidia's chief executive. The document points to intensified intelligence operations targeted at semiconductor leadership.
point1: A U.S. intelligence memo reports an espionage attempt targeting Nvidia's CEO.
point2: China's Ministry of State Security allegedly recruited a technology executive from Megaspeed.

title: Oil Companies Refute Karnataka's Report on Excessive Ethanol Blending
summary: State-owned oil marketing companies have rejected claims by the Karnataka state government that petrol samples contained up to 31% ethanol. OMCs reported that 56 samples tested across the state showed an average ethanol content of 19.3%, within the legal E20 threshold.
point1: OMCs contested Karnataka's findings alleging fuel samples exceeded allowable ethanol limits.
point2: Official tests conducted by OMCs showed average ethanol concentration at 19.3%.

title: US Offers $20 Million Reward for Info on Iran Nuclear Program
summary: The United States has announced a $20 million reward for actionable information concerning Iran's nuclear program. The action comes as U.S. President Donald Trump raises the possibility of renewing military strikes against Iranian nuclear sites.
point1: The U.S. government announced a $20 million reward for intelligence on Iran's nuclear capabilities.
point2: The reward highlights heightened geopolitical tensions and military posturing between Washington and Tehran.

title: Gunman Kills at Least Six People in Krakow Main Square
summary: A gunman wearing military fatigues opened fire in the main square of Krakow, Poland, killing at least six people. Authorities have commenced an investigation into the fatal shooting in the country's second-largest city.
point1: At least six people were killed in a shooting in Krakow, Poland.
point2: The assailant opened fire in the city's main square while dressed in military fatigues.

title: Binance CFO Steps Down Following $6.3 Billion Cryptocurrency Hack
summary: The Chief Financial Officer of Binance is leaving the cryptocurrency exchange to pursue a new venture. The departure comes shortly after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of cryptocurrency from Binance users.
point1: Binance's CFO announced his departure following a massive security compromise.
point2: Hackers stole $6.3 billion in user digital assets from the platform.

title: IndiGo Flight Emergency Returns to Bengaluru Over Hijack Threat Note
summary: An IndiGo flight bound for Lucknow made an emergency turnaround to Bengaluru's Kempegowda International Airport after a hijack threat note was discovered onboard. Security personnel immediately launched inspection protocols upon landing.
point1: IndiGo Flight 6E-451 returned to Bengaluru after cabin crew found a note threatening a hijacking.
point2: Airport and aviation security agencies inspected the aircraft and initiated an investigation.

title: Indian Government Mandates Rice and Paddy Stock Declarations Amid Price Surge
summary: The Union government of India has mandated mandatory reporting of rice and paddy holdings to prevent market hoarding. Additionally, five southern states have been empowered to impose stock limits on traders and millers.
point1: The central government mandated stock disclosures for rice and paddy and authorized stock limits across five states.
point2: The measures aim to stabilize market availability and curb rising retail prices.

title: ONGC Seeks Operatorship Rights for Venezuelan Oil Projects
summary: India's state-owned Oil and Natural Gas Corporation expects to secure operational rights for its Venezuelan petroleum ventures. ONGC currently holds a 40% stake in the San Cristobal oil project and an 11% stake in Carabobo.
point1: ONGC is preparing to take over direct operatorship of key energy projects in Venezuela.
point2: Acquiring operational control strengthens India's overseas energy assets and operational management.
point3: ONGC expects to acquire the operatorship rights within 3 to 6 months.

title: Russian Strikes Damage Ukrainian Energy Infrastructure Ahead of Abu Dhabi Talks
summary: A fresh round of Russian missile and drone attacks injured nine people and damaged Ukraine's power network. The escalation occurred immediately prior to scheduled trilateral negotiations involving Ukrainian and Russian representatives in Abu Dhabi.
point1: Russian military strikes wounded nine people and damaged Ukraine's electrical grid.
point2: The strikes disrupt key infrastructure ahead of sensitive diplomatic talks.
point3: Trilateral talks involving Ukrainian and Russian delegations are scheduled in Abu Dhabi next week.

title: New Zealand Election Ends Without Clear Winner, Coalition Talks Ahead
summary: Preliminary election results in New Zealand indicate a deeply divided national parliament with no single party winning a majority. The inconclusive outcome sets up extended coalition negotiations between major parties.
point1: Preliminary vote tallies show no clear winner in New Zealand's general election.
point2: Parties will need to form a coalition government to achieve a parliamentary majority.
point3: Weeks of coalition talks are expected to follow the announcement of preliminary results.

title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming AI Data Center Facility to Google
summary: Data center developer Crusoe has sold its troubled Wyoming facility project to Google. The transaction underscores the significant financial and development hurdles involved in building massive AI data infrastructure.
point1: Crusoe sold its delayed Wyoming data center development project to Google.
point2: The deal illustrates rising power and infrastructure challenges facing large-scale AI data centers.

title: Trump Names Stephen Miller as White House Chief of Staff
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has appointed conservative loyalist Stephen Miller as his new White House chief of staff. The appointment of the immigration policy architect is expected to lead to major policy battles with Congress.
point1: Stephen Miller has been selected to serve as the new White House chief of staff.
point2: Miller was previously the key architect of hardline immigration enforcement policies in the administration.

title: Paraguay's President Impeached and Placed Under House Arrest Following Banking Crisis
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has been impeached and placed under house arrest following a severe national banking collapse. The crisis left millions of citizens unable to access their deposited funds.
point1: Santiago Peña was ousted from office and placed under house arrest following the collapse of major banks.
point2: The banking sector failure cut off millions of Paraguayan citizens from accessing their money.

title: Tests show open-weight Chinese AI models demonstrate high-level hacking capabilities
summary: Security researchers testing open-weight Chinese AI models found that systems like DeepSeek and GLM executed network penetration tasks with high proficiency. Their automated exploitation skills approached performance levels recorded by restricted frontier models.
point1: Open-weight AI models DeepSeek and GLM demonstrated advanced network intrusion capabilities in controlled testing.
point2: The research highlights growing cybersecurity risks from publicly accessible autonomous penetration models.

title: Pentagon conditionally approves $250 million loan for battery material maker 6K
summary: The U.S. Department of Defense has conditionally approved a $250 million loan for battery technology startup 6K. The financing will support the construction of a domestic commercial facility to scale microwave-plasma battery materials.
point1: The Pentagon granted conditional approval for a $250 million loan to 6K.
point2: The funding expands domestic U.S. supply chain capacity for critical battery materials.

title: Hundreds of Artex AI Hacking Tool Servers Found Exposed Online
summary: Security researchers discovered hundreds of internet-connected servers hosting the Artex AI penetration testing tool exposed publicly. The exposure allows unauthenticated users access to the automated hacking software.
point1: Hundreds of servers operating Artex AI security testing software were left publicly accessible.
point2: The exposure permits unrestricted access to automated cyber testing tools online.

title: India's Foreign Exchange Reserves Drop $2.69 Billion to $717 Billion
summary: India's foreign exchange reserves declined by $2.69 billion to stand at $717 billion, according to central bank data. Financial analysts attributed the drawdown to foreign currency resource deployment and Reserve Bank interventions in the dollar market.
point1: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $2.69 billion down to $717 billion.
point2: Dollar sales by the central bank to support the rupee contributed to the decline.

title: European Prosecutors Probe EU Rail Funds Following Fatal Spanish Train Crash
summary: European prosecutors have opened a fraud investigation into EU funds designated for upgrading a railway line in Spain. The probe follows a fatal train derailment in Urda, Spain, that killed 69 people.
point1: European authorities launched a fraud inquiry into EU funds spent on Spanish rail upgrades.
point2: The investigation was initiated after a railway disaster in Urda left 69 dead.

title: OpenAI Reportedly Raises Additional $11 Billion at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion in capital as part of an unclosed funding round. The investment values the artificial intelligence firm at $1.25 trillion.
point1: OpenAI secured $11 billion in new funding.
point2: The deal elevates OpenAI's valuation to $1.25 trillion.
point3: The funding round is expected to close in the coming weeks.

title: Corporate Spending on AI Stalls Despite Rising Usage, Ramp Data Shows
summary: Data from corporate spend management platform Ramp shows corporate expenditure on AI tools has leveled off even as active software usage continues to grow. Price reductions and cost controls among major enterprise users are moderating revenue expansion across AI vendors.
point1: Ramp transaction data indicates enterprise AI spending has plateaued despite increasing user activity.
point2: Corporate clients are increasingly adopting tighter budget controls and lower-cost model tiers.

title: Meta Warns Local Political Opposition to Data Centers Threatens AI Expansion
summary: Meta warned that growing political opposition to data centers could restrict future artificial intelligence infrastructure. The warning follows U.S. midterm elections where voters approved restrictions on data center developments in 40 of 41 ballot measures.
point1: Meta cautioned that public opposition to data centers threatens planned AI capacity expansions.
point2: Voters across multiple jurisdictions passed local ballot measures restricting data center construction due to power and resource concerns.

title: Somali Supreme Court Strikes Down Presidential Term Extension
summary: Somalia's Supreme Court has rejected a proposed extension of the president's term in office. The judicial decision adds uncertainty to planned nationwide elections set for next year.
point1: Somalia's highest court ruled against extending the president's official tenure.
point2: The ruling invalidates term extension efforts amid opposition challenges ahead of direct national elections.
point3: Somalia's nationwide elections remain scheduled for 2027.

title: Pope Leo Embarks on Latin America Visit Following Lung Surgery
summary: Pope Leo has begun an extended trip to Latin America, with scheduled stops in Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru. The international journey comes weeks after the pontiff underwent surgery to remove part of a lung.
point1: Pope Leo departed on a multi-country Latin American tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru.
point2: The trip marks his first major international travel following lung cancer surgery last month.
point3: The pastoral visit will proceed across the three nations over the coming days.

title: European Airlines Hit by Wave of Hoax Bomb Threats
summary: Numerous commercial flights across Europe were impacted by a series of bomb threats made against airlines. Security authorities confirmed that no explosives were found on any searched planes.
point1: Scores of flights across multiple European airlines received targeted bomb threats.
point2: Inspections revealed no active explosives aboard affected aircraft.
point3: Security investigations into the origin of the threats are ongoing.

title: Kenyan Doomsday Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Sentenced to Life Imprisonment
summary: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie has been sentenced to life in prison for the murder of 191 people. Mackenzie directed his followers to starve themselves and their children to death in a forest to fulfill a religious command.
point1: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to life imprisonment following his conviction for 191 murders.
point2: The ruling concludes legal proceedings surrounding one of the mass starvation cases in recent history.

title: CBI Registers ₹904 Crore Bank Fraud Case Against Future Retail and Kishore Biyani
summary: India's Central Bureau of Investigation has booked Future Retail and founder Kishore Biyani over an alleged ₹904 crore bank fraud. The action follows a complaint by State Bank of India alleging improper utilization of loan facilities.
point1: The CBI booked Future Retail and founder Kishore Biyani in a ₹904 crore fraud case.
point2: State Bank of India alleged that credit facilities were diverted contrary to approved bank terms.
point3: CBI searches and legal proceedings remain ongoing in Mumbai.

title: ADNOC Signs 10-Year LNG Supply Deal with Gujarat Energy
summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company has signed a 10-year liquefied natural gas supply agreement with Gujarat Energy. The deal marks ADNOC's fifth long-term LNG contract with an Indian entity.
point1: ADNOC finalized a 10-year LNG supply and purchase deal with Gujarat Energy.
point2: The agreement secures long-term natural gas supplies to meet energy demands in Western India.
point3: Deliveries will proceed under the contracted 10-year timeline.

title: Fox Completes $22 Billion Acquisition of Roku
summary: Fox has officially completed its $22 billion acquisition of streaming giant Roku. The deal closed several months after Department of Justice investigators reviewed the merger.
point1: Fox finalized its acquisition of Roku in a deal valued at $22 billion.
point2: The merger represents a major consolidation of traditional media and digital streaming hardware and platforms.
